title: AudioStreamInteractive applies unintentional fade-in when transitioning with a filler clip
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.8.dev [e7cfa294a], v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf], v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (e18658105) - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:26:35 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors (2560x1440 @ 239.88 Hz, 2400x1350 @ 119.91 Hz, 1440x1080 @ 74.92 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (radeonsi, gfx1201, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.2.6-1-cachyos) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 61.94 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When an `AudioStreamInteractive` performs a transition which has no fade-in configured (i.e. `Fade Mode` is set to `Disabled` or `Fade-Out`) but does have a filler clip set, an unintentional 1 second fade-in is applied.

The same fade-in is *not* applied if no filler clip is used; in that case the next clip correctly starts at full volume.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Set up an `AudioStreamInteractive` with 2 main clips and a filler clip.
2. Configure a transition from one clip to another with "Fade Mode" set to "Disabled".
3. At this point, observe that the next clip plays immediately at full volume.
4. Set the filler clip on the transition.
5. Now observe the 1-second fade-in that occurs.

Here is a video of the MRP with **no** filler clip, there is an audible beep at the start of the drum clip:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0081d6c4-bacd-4271-bcdf-9c55b2a55635

And here is the same transition, this time with a filler clip, and the beep is inaudible:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a09d883f-da7b-47b5-81f1-22edb55dfcb4

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The MRP is set up with a simple music track and a drum sound to transition to. The drum sound has a very short harsh beep added to the start, which becomes nearly inaudible when a filter clip is used. The filler clip is simply 1 second of silence.

Archive: [audio-stream-interactive-fade-test-main.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33039043/audio-stream-interactive-fade-test-main.zip)

GitHub: https://github.com/apples/audio-stream-interactive-fade-test/tree/issue-mrp
